chapters.title: From the Microsoft Graph backbone to Work IQ
Why AI projects fail and the management model
The 2026 inflection point, readiness and the first 90 days

takeaways: Work IQ adds a persistent context and memory layer on top of Microsoft Graph, turning Microsoft 365 from a storage system into a reasoning system.
Because Work IQ respects existing permissions, oversharing, stale sites and weak sensitivity labels become immediate risks, so data cleanup and governance must come before deployment.
Measure decision speed, context reuse and outcome quality instead of activity, and start with one high-value workflow measured at 30, 60 and 90 days.
hook: Work IQ turns your Microsoft 365 tenant from a filing cabinet into a reasoning system that sees every permission gap, bottleneck and broken process. This episode is for IT leaders and governance owners who need to prepare data, policies and management models before agents start acting on that intelligence, with a practical readiness check and a 90-day starting plan.
